BiblicalUsage: Mo'al is the lifting up of the hands — Ezra blesses the LORD, and all the people answer Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands, and bow their heads and worship.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lifted hands are the body's Amen: the whole person agrees with what the mouth has said.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
